name: Formidable Dimension
source:
You were given a mysterious invitation. Inside the invitation lies a strange puzzle. What would you do?

Rachel Reid endures ongoing bullying from her childhood friend turned enemy. Approaching a breaking point and having no support from others, Rachel receives an unexpected invitation called The New Beginning. What lies within this invitation and why do you need to solve this puzzle? 

You're instructed to complete the puzzle to obtain a location to see the New Beginning. You're also instructed to not tell anyone or else your invitation gets revoked. Can you solve it and reach the location before 7pm? Or would you discard the invitation? 

[From [url=https://ashsmara.itch.io/fd-ep1demo]Itch.io[/url]]
